title.purpose: Conversation title in the 56px title bar; weight, not size, carries it.

prose.purpose: Assistant replies rendered as Markdown; inner headings scale from it in em.

body.purpose: App default: prompts, conversation items, composer. Tabular numerals on.

label.purpose: Buttons (13.5px) and version tabs (13px; current tab 600).

meta.purpose: Per-reply metadata line (model, tokens, stop reason) and edit hints.

group-label.purpose: Date groups in the conversation list, sentence case.

code.purpose: JetBrains Mono, only inside fenced and inline code.

shadows.name: composer-lift
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift on the docked composer over the scrolled transcript.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: The sidebar only, while open as the narrow-screen drawer.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every state transition.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on buttons, items, composer.

motion.name: duration-thread
motion.purpose: Tab underline colour and the selected-item padding opening for the weft tick.

motion.name: duration-drawer
motion.purpose: Sidebar drawer slide on narrow screens.

motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: Madder block caret while a reply streams.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

breakpoints.name: drawer
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: sidebar becomes a drawer, stats and keyboard hint hidden, gutters drop to 16px.

focus.purpose: Indigo on paper, linen on the sidebar and in dark mode. Version tabs inset the outline (-2px).

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Working Loom"**

Loom's interface is cloth on a frame. Indigo is the warp: it holds the whole sidebar, the fixed structure every conversation hangs from. Madder is the weft: a single thread that crosses the structure only where something is chosen or about to happen (the selected conversation, the current version, the Send action). Linen-tinted paper is the ground for reading, and Ink is the text. Nothing else is coloured.

The screen is a working tool, not a showcase. Density is calm desktop density: a fixed sidebar, a 56px title bar, and a single centred 720px reading column with the composer docked beneath it. Replies are full-width formatted prose; prompts sit as quiet sunk blocks offset to the right. The signature of the system is that structure is drawn where it happens: a turn with sibling versions carries a tab strip directly above it, so the message tree is legible in place.

Light and dark are one world seen at different hours. Dark mode comes from the dark app icon: an ink ground, linen text, a deeper indigo sidebar, and a lighter madder that keeps its contrast on dark.
keyCharacteristics: Two-colour structure: indigo shell, paper reading ground; madder only as the selection or action thread.
One sans family (Work Sans) for all UI and prose; JetBrains Mono only inside code.
Flat, tonal surfaces; depth comes from paper value steps, not shadows.
Branch points shown as tabs above the turn, never hidden behind arrows.
The woven mark is redrawn as SVG and takes its thread colours from CSS, so it re-weaves itself on every ground.

rules.name: The One Thread Rule
rules.body: Madder marks a choice or an action: what is selected, what is current, what will send. It is never a decorative fill, a heading colour, or a background wash. If removing the madder from an element would not change what the user can do or see as chosen, it should not be madder.

rules.name: The Warp Holds Rule
rules.body: Indigo is structure, not accent. It fills the sidebar and colours the mark; it does not appear as button fills, links, or highlights inside the reading pane. Focus rings on paper are indigo because focus is structural.

rules.name: The Thread Changes On Indigo Rule
rules.body: Any madder element placed on the indigo sidebar uses Sidebar Weft, never base Madder.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Work Sans sets everything that is not code. Do not introduce a second sans, a serif for headings, or the mono for labels and numbers; tabular numerals in Work Sans already handle token counts.

rules.name: The Wordmark Is Not Type Rule
rules.body: The serif lowercase "loom" is an image (extracted from the primary lockup and applied as a CSS mask so it takes `currentColor`). Never set it, or any UI text, in a serif font.

rules.name: The Paper Steps Rule
rules.body: To separate a surface, step its paper value (sunk or raised) or draw a Rule. Reach for a shadow only when the surface genuinely floats over scrolling content.

dos: **Do** keep Madder to selection, current state, and the primary action (The One Thread Rule).
**Do** switch any madder element on the sidebar to Sidebar Weft.
**Do** separate surfaces by stepping paper value (sunk / raised) or a 1px Rule before reaching for a shadow.
**Do** draw tree structure where it happens: a version strip directly above the turn that branches.
**Do** set every non-code string in Work Sans; use the mono only for code.
**Do** use the shared button weights (primary, quiet, outline) at 32px rather than inventing new button styles.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: all transitions and animations drop to 0ms.
**Do** define every new colour as a token on `:root` with a dark-mode counterpart.
donts: **Don't** use Indigo inside the reading pane as an accent, link, or button fill.
**Don't** put base Madder on Indigo; it falls below legible contrast there.
**Don't** hide branch points behind small "2/3" arrows under a message.
**Don't** set the wordmark, or any UI text, in a serif face.
**Don't** box assistant replies in bubbles; replies are open prose on paper.
**Don't** treat this palette or mark as final; the brand is provisional (see the note at the top).
